scope: Read-only integration review after parser-budget fix; no repository/source/test/version mutations and no broad test rerun.

checks.result: The four required saved-source fields are descriptor-checked. Optional parameterContract is read via its own data descriptor, strictly captured and omitted on failure; a getter/serializer cannot obtain a callback. Unsupported/modified/unavailable/incompatible advice disables only completion, preserving manual JSON and ordinary review.

Owner equality pins session/catalog/source references, binding ID, backend/language, creator epoch and catalog-read epoch. Pending/dirty/stale/disposed contexts cannot apply. Catalog refresh increments epoch before await, clones fresh data and invalidates previous source ownership. Explicit mutation rechecks the exact current fragment; parent captures and rechecks immediately before replacing only its local textarea.

parameterDisplay retains original fragment bytes separately from browser newline normalization. Each stable binding owns its own parametersContent. Source selection/add-binding never silently fills defaults; completion invalidates the old preview. Incomplete input and failed oversized completion are retained. Language changes and script suspend/resume keep raw input without granting a saved review.

Provider inspection consumes the same bounded captured TXT bytes as sourceRevision; lazy optional core loading does not reread the source. Ordinary scripts retain four fields; fixed providers add only a bounded frozen contract. Authenticated no-store route and candidate budgets remain unchanged; source text and filesystem roots are not returned or executed.

UI supplies only identities to the unchanged strict planner, embeds explicitly edited fragments by source ranges, and sends the old behavior.create command shape. Existing world/scene revisions, complete scalar manifest inspection, document registration/dependencies, scene build and recovery evidence are recomputed. Apply recaptures under the original registry lock. Optional catalog advice does not grant persistence or bypass domain validation.

The VM bridge transports own data descriptors, rejects getters/functions/symbols and caches one transported source per original identity, preserving the stale-control comparisons. Prototype normalization is fixture transport, not a production validator: malicious prototype assertions belong at the actual pure boundary. The bridge does not replace final transaction checks or prove actual Chrome layout.

evidenceBoundary.newUi18AndIntegrated55: Read the actual new tests and reviewed integration paths; parent/UI agents executed these groups. This review does not claim an additional rerun of them.

evidenceBoundary.remainingAcceptance: Real Chrome parameter completion/save and backend run remain separate acceptance tasks; the earlier script-return smoke does not establish new parameter UI acceptance.
